build_huggingface_embeddings: build a HuggingfaceEmbeddings module to create multimodal embeddings from text and image modalities with token, position, and segment embeddings
build_huggingface_backend: build a HuggingfaceBackend transformer backend that loads a pretrained Huggingface model and replaces layers with JIT-compatible versions
generate_multimodal_embeddings: generate multimodal embeddings from token ids, position ids, and segment ids using the HuggingfaceEmbeddings forward pass
generate_attention_mask: generate an extended attention mask by concatenating input masks and scaling with negative values for masked positions
generate_encoded_layers: generate encoded transformer layers by passing embeddings through the Huggingface encoder and returning last and all layer outputs
